# Traceability Checklist: ERCP Training Pipeline Baseline

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality and cross-artifact traceability across spec, plan, and tasks before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-05-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all functional requirements in [spec.md](../spec.md) mapped to one or more implementation tasks with explicit IDs? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements, Tasks §All Phases]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements for preprocessing extensibility explicitly defined beyond current operations list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004a]
- [ ] CHK003 Are per-class evaluation output requirements fully specified for all four labels, including expected artifact types? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 Are dataset split handling requirements complete for both presence and absence of validation folders? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-009a]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the term stable model interface contract defined with objective acceptance signals for reviewers? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK006 Are border preserving zoom requirements precise enough to distinguish unchanged border from transformed content area? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Are run metadata requirements explicitly defined so configuration changes can be objectively verified? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Do scope constraints in [plan.md](../plan.md) consistently reflect the single mock model requirement in [spec.md](../spec.md)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002a, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK009 Are evaluation expectations consistent between baseline evaluation reuse and Grad-CAM output requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-012a]
- [ ] CHK010 Do clarification statements align with functional requirements without introducing alternate interpretations? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §Requirements]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK011 Can SC-001 through SC-006 be objectively assessed with explicit evidence references in plan or tasks? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria, Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Are success criteria free of implementation-prescriptive wording while still testable by reviewers? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK013 Are primary, alternate, and exception scenario requirements represented in user stories and edge cases? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined for failure scenarios involving unreadable images and invalid preprocessing bounds? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are boundary conditions for low-sample classes in uniform sampling specified with explicit expected behavior? [Edge Case, Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK016 Is fallback behavior defined when black-border detection is uncertain or fails? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 Are performance expectations quantified sufficiently for reviewer-level acceptance decisions? [Non-Functional, Clarity, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK018 Are reproducibility requirements defined for repeated runs across imbalance modes and preprocessing strategies? [Non-Functional, Gap]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK019 Are assumptions about environment readiness and dataset authority explicitly linked to implementation constraints? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK020 Are external dependency expectations documented for Grad-CAM and image processing capabilities? [Dependency, Gap]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK021 Are any unresolved ambiguous qualifiers such as comparable interpretable or stable identified and clarified with measurable criteria? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-005, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK022 Is there any conflict between task ordering and dependency statements for story independence claims? [Conflict, Tasks §Dependencies and Execution Order]
